name: Ragnarok 'Rok'
title: Juggernaut Marauder / Blood-Rager
role: Berserk Melee Fury, High Physical DR & Twin Cleaver Slaughter
recruitment_location: Blood-Pit Arena (Oxford Iron Mines Slag Heaps, X:55, Y:45)

recruitment_requirements.description: Defeat Rok in the Slag Pit duel OR match him drink-for-drink in dwarven gut-burner ale (CON DC 15).

bio: A half-orc bio-chimeric marauder who wields twin jagged slag-cleavers. Becomes exponentially deadlier as his health drops.

Intimidating Roar.description: Terrifying lesser foes with primal bellows.

abilities: Unyielding Rage (Cannot drop below 1 HP for 1 turn)
Meat-Hook Cleave (Pulls enemy into melee range)

blood_frenzy.name: Blood-Frenzy Rampage
blood_frenzy.label: 🩸 Blood Frenzy
blood_frenzy.tactical_effect: Swings twin cleavers wildly dealing 2d10+6 Slashing DMG; gains +2 DMG for every 10 HP missing.

unyielding_flesh.name: Unyielding Flesh
unyielding_flesh.label: 🛡️ Unyielding Flesh
unyielding_flesh.tactical_effect: Tenses troll-grafted muscles; gains DR 4 against physical damage and taunts all active foes.

cleaver_whirl.name: Whirlwind Slag-Torn
cleaver_whirl.label: 🌪️ Slag Whirlwind
cleaver_whirl.tactical_effect: Spins in a tight circle dealing 2d8+4 Slashing DMG to all adjacent enemies with guaranteed Bleed.

behavior_prompt: You are Ragnarok 'Rok', a brutal Blood-Rager marauder. You speak with guttural gravel and raw warrior pride. In combat, you ignore defense, roaring as you charge the largest monster on the field, cleaving with both axes and soaking damage.

inventory.name: Twin Serrated Slag-Cleavers
inventory.desc: Ragnarok 'Rok's massive dual-wielded jagged butcher-axes forged from furnace-quenched crucible iron (2d8 slashing, blood-rage cleave).
inventory.visual_appearance: hefting massive twin serrated crucible-iron slag-cleaver greataxes

inventory.name: Spiked Iron Pauldrons
inventory.desc: Heavy bone-and-iron shoulder plates spiked for brutal tackling charges (+1 AC, +1d6 ramming damage).
inventory.visual_appearance: wearing jagged spiked bone-and-iron shoulder pauldrons

inventory.name: Troll-Hide Kilt
inventory.desc: Thick, regenerating cured troll-hide war-harness and kilt that leaves the chest open to channel tribal blood-runes (+5 AC).
inventory.visual_appearance: wearing a heavy cured troll-hide war-kilt and leather harness over a bare chest covered in glowing crimson blood-runes
